I will spread one bag of NPK fertilizer on this plot because my elder brother did the same last year and his maize cobs were big. I will plant the seed I kept from last season's harvest — I do not have cash to buy new seed from the agro-dealer. My wife and I will do all the work ourselves, weeding three times and harvesting by hand, so I do not need to hire anyone. I will not spray chemicals or irrigate because the rain here is enough and those things cost too much money.
